title: American Pickers
description:

Mike and Frank bet on who's the best picker while on the road in Pennsylvania, with the loser having to clean their smelly and filthy van; the guys meet "Mole Man" Ron, a picker with a mostly hand-built, 26-room underground lair.

title: American Pickers

description:
S07 E09 — The Plot to Kill Lincoln
A shot rings out from the balcony of the Ford's Theater in Washington, D.C., and America's 16th president, Abraham Lincoln, has been killed.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S04 E04 — The Lost Colony of Roanoke
In 1587, a group of settlers land off the coast of North Carolina on Roanoke Island to establish the first English Colony in America; a few years later, the 115 men, women and children vanish without a trace, leaving only cryptic clues.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S04 E13 — The Search for Noah's Ark
It's one of the most famous stories from the Bible; for thousands of years the tale of Noah's Ark is shared, but little is known about what happened to the ark.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S07 E06 — The Murder of Sam Giancana
The notorious mafia kingpin Sam Giancana is shot execution style in his own home.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S05 E07 — The Battle of Los Angeles
On February 24, 1942, less than three months after the Japanese bombed Pearl Harbor, military radar picks up what appears to be enemy aircraft over Los Angeles.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S04 E07 — The \"Missingest\" Man in America
In 1930, a New York Supreme Court justice with close ties to Tammany Hall, and future president Franklin Delano Roosevelt, steps out of a steakhouse and disappears; for decades, the case dominates mainstream media and remains unsolved.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S06 E09 — The Amazing Events of the Book of Exodus
The Burning Bush, the 10 Plagues, the Parting of the Red Sea these Biblical events in the Book of Exodus have shaped Judeo-Christian beliefs for centuries.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S07 E04 — The Theft of the Mona Lisa: Case Closed
The world's most famous painting vanishes in a daring heist, sparking international outrage and a global manhunt.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S06 E14 — Secrets of the Copper Scroll
This is the mystery of the Dead Sea Scrolls; an ancient treasure map, recorded on a rare Copper Scroll, could lead to billions of dollars of buried treasure in gold, silver and jewels, hidden away thousands of years ago from Roman invaders.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S05 E01 — Montezuma's Lost Treasure
An Aztec king's glittering treasure vanishes into thin air, inspiring a 500-year search that spans continents; one of the greatest warriors of all-time amassed a vast horde believed to be worth more than $3 billion today.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S07 E16 — The Shot Heard Round the World
When the British Red Coats march into Lexington in 1775 prepared for a surprise attack, they are met with a small scrappy militia ready for a fight; it's the battle that kicked off the American Revolution.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S06 E06 — The Death and Fortune of Pablo Escobar
Pablo Escobar, the narco-trafficker who single-handedly supplied most of America's cocaine in the 1980s, had billions of dollars in cash; by the time he was gunned down in 1993, it's believed he was worth over $50 billion in today's money.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S06 E19 — The Secrets of Easter Island
The gigantic statues of Easter Island have mystified humanity for centuries; how in the world did an ancient civilization, with only primitive tools, carve and then move thousands of these rock monuments around the island, and why?

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S03 E11 — Lindbergh Baby Kidnapping
When the infant son of an aviation legend is snatched from his crib at home, it ignites a media firestorm; after a nationwide manhunt, the supposed culprit is brought to justice, but questions pop up on the investigation.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S04 E03 — The Assassination of JFK
On November 22, 1963, President John F. Kennedy was assassinated, shaking the nation to its core; while an initial suspect is captured, many believe there's more to the story; investigators and amateur sleuths alike have been searching for answers.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S07 E03 — The Legend of the Werewolf
It's one of humanity's oldest nightmares-at the full moon, werewolves that once were men hunt human prey and then feast on their flesh.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S04 E05 — The Phoenix Lights Phenomenon
In 1997, thousands of people across Phoenix witness a series of strange lights unlike anything they've ever seen; many think this could be one of the largest-scale UFO sightings in history, but there may be another explanation.
